answer: Honeypot tasks, seeded with a known-bad answer. Every batch hides one comet job whose correct output is already recorded, so whoever returns the bad answer is caught by construction. Failure is published with the address attached. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a copied result from an earlier batch fails. A 200-identity farm burns one batch per detection, and a gale of nonce mismatches puts the whole mesa on the public list.
